doc.english: Provides selected ECS RPC operations generated from pinned metadata. Clients are concurrency safe; inputs are copied. Shared runtime errors and cancellation preserve their identity. Coverage is limited to the listed operations and fields.
doc.chinese: 由固定元数据生成选定 ECS RPC 操作。客户端并发安全，输入被复制；共享运行时保留错误及取消的身份。覆盖限于列出的操作和字段。

doc.english: Executes one RPC request through the shared runtime; nil input uses zero values unless required. Callers must not mutate input concurrently.
doc.chinese: 通过共享运行时执行一次 RPC 请求；除必填输入外，nil 输入使用零值。调用者不得并发修改输入。

doc.english: Defaults to the client region; a per-call region override takes precedence.
doc.chinese: 默认使用客户端地域，调用级地域覆盖优先。

doc.chinese: 包含最多 100 个非空 ID，编码前复制切片。

doc.english: Selects a continuation token on input; an empty output token ends token pagination.
doc.chinese: 输入选择续页 token，输出 token 为空表示 token 分页结束。

doc.english: Selects token page size; zero omits it and the service defaults to ten. Token and page-number parameters cannot be combined.
doc.chinese: 选择 token 页大小；零值省略，服务默认十条。token 参数与页码参数不能混用。
